prompt:
超写实夜间公园双人抓拍摄影，竖版约 3:4，两名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，并排坐在公园长椅 / 低矮座椅上，摄影者位于两人正前方非常近的位置，使用约 24–28mm 等效手机广角镜头，机位略低于胸口，人物上半身占据画面主体，呈明显的近距离夜间手机自拍 / 他拍质感。

两人都为自然丰满沙漏型身材，肩部中等偏窄，胸部明显丰满，腰部纤细，髋部自然圆润。不要纸片身材、窄胯细腿或健美肌肉。

左侧人物留乌黑色超长直发，头发自然披在右肩和胸前，身体略朝右侧人物靠近。左臂高高弯曲到脑后，手掌扶住后脑或头发，右手自然落在腰胯附近。头部转向右侧，看着旁边的人，嘴唇微张，像正在说话。颈部佩戴一圈银色水钻 / 金属短项链。

右侧人物留乌黑色超长直发，中分，头发从两侧垂到腰部附近，上半身微微后靠，身体向左侧人物倾斜，头部略低并朝镜头方向转，表情冷静、轻微慵懒。

两人都穿亮玫红 / 洋红色内衣风上装，颜色高饱和、偏冷粉。左侧为带钢圈的深 V 聚拢文胸式上衣，罩杯表面为细腻哑光或轻微蕾丝纹理；右侧同样为亮玫红色文胸式上衣，罩杯更圆润，中央有细小连接结构。下身只露出少量同色系低腰内搭边缘，并搭配松垮垂在腰胯位置的灰色运动裤 / 休闲裤，裤腰明显下移，形成随手披着外套或刚脱下一层衣服的自然状态，但保持正常完整覆盖。

左侧人物外搭一件浅灰色宽松连帽卫衣 / 开衫，衣服从肩膀滑落，只挂在手臂和身体侧面；右侧人物肩部和手臂基本裸露，腰侧也有灰色衣物自然堆积。

场景为夜晚城市公园：背景有大片深绿色树冠、草坪、长椅、步道和远处建筑。顶部左侧有一盏非常亮的暖白色路灯，强光照亮附近树叶并形成局部过曝；更远处零散分布几盏小型公园灯。树木和草地大部分陷入深色阴影，整体环境安静、低照度。

光线以公园路灯＋手机夜景模式 / 轻微自动提亮为主，不要强直闪。人物脸部、胸肩和皮肤处在偏暗的暖冷混合光下，左侧人物略亮，右侧人物更多落入阴影。画面允许轻微运动模糊、暗部噪点和高 ISO 颗粒，人物边缘不要过于锐利。

整体呈 真实 iPhone 夜拍 / 2000s–2010s 数码相机夜间抓拍质感：低照度、暗部颗粒明显、曝光不完全均匀、树叶和背景略糊、肤色自然偏暖、亮粉色服装成为画面主要色彩焦点。

重点锁定：两名成年东亚女性＋夜晚公园＋近距离双人构图＋超长黑直发＋自然丰满沙漏身材＋亮玫红色文胸式上装＋灰色宽松衣物滑落在肩臂和腰胯＋左侧人物一手举到脑后＋两人彼此靠近＋树木草坪＋强路灯＋低照度手机夜拍＋轻微噪点和模糊。

避免：白天、室内卧室、摄影棚、强闪光、精致商业布光、短发、高马尾、运动装完全覆盖、黑色内衣、红色礼服、夸张健美身材、极端巨臀、背景严重虚化、HDR 过强、塑料皮肤、动漫脸、CG 感、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en: Hyper-realistic night park candid photography of two people, vertical roughly 3:4 aspect ratio, two clearly adult East Asian women in their 20s+, sitting side by side on a park bench / low seating. The photographer is positioned very close directly in front of them, using an equivalent 24–28mm smartphone wide-angle lens, camera angle slightly below chest level, with their upper bodies dominating the frame, capturing a distinct close-up night mobile phone selfie / candid snapshot texture. Both have naturally voluptuous hourglass figures, moderate-to-narrow shoulders, distinctly full busts, slim waists, and naturally rounded hips. No stick-thin bodies, narrow hips, skinny legs, or athletic muscular physiques. The person on the left has jet-black, extra-long straight hair naturally draped over her right shoulder and chest, her body leaning slightly toward the person on the right. Her left arm is bent high behind her head with her palm resting against the back of her head or hair, while her right hand rests naturally near her waist and hip. Her head is turned to the right, looking at the person beside her with lips slightly parted as if speaking. She wears a silver rhinestone / metallic short choker necklace around her neck. The person on the right has jet-black, extra-long straight hair parted in the middle, cascading down both sides to around her waist; her upper body leans slightly back and tilts toward the person on the left, with her head slightly lowered and turned toward the camera, showing a calm, subtly languid expression. Both are wearing bright rose-pink / magenta lingerie-style tops with high saturation and cool-pink undertones. The left wears an underwire deep-V push-up bra-style top with a delicate matte or subtle lace texture; the right also wears a bright rose-pink bra-style top with rounder cups and a delicate small center connecting detail. The lower half reveals only a small edge of matching low-rise undergarments, paired with baggy gray sweatpants / lounge pants hanging loosely around the hips and waist, the waistband visibly lowered to create a natural, effortless look as if casually draping an outer layer or just shedding clothes, while maintaining proper, complete coverage. The person on the left wears a light gray loose hooded sweatshirt / cardigan slipping off the shoulders, hanging only from her arms and sides; the person on the right has mostly bare shoulders and arms, with gray fabric naturally bunched at her waist. The scene is a city park at night: background features a large dark-green tree canopy, lawn, bench, pathway, and distant buildings. At the top left, a very bright warm-white streetlamp strongly illuminates nearby leaves, causing localized overexposure; further away, a few small park lamps are sparsely scattered. Trees and grass are mostly submerged in deep shadows, creating a quiet, low-light overall ambiance. Lighting is primarily park streetlamp plus smartphone night mode / subtle auto-exposure boost, without harsh direct flash. The subjects' faces, chests, shoulders, and skin are bathed in dim, mixed warm-and-cool ambient light, with the left figure slightly brighter and the right figure falling more into shadow. The image allows slight motion blur, shadow noise, and high-ISO grain; figure edges should not be overly sharp. The overall aesthetic presents a genuine iPhone night shot / 2000s–2010s digital camera night candid feel: low light, visible shadow grain, uneven exposure, slightly blurred leaves and background, naturally warm skin tones, and bright pink clothing serving as the primary color focal point. Key focus: two adult East Asian women + night park + close-up two-person composition + extra-long straight black hair + naturally voluptuous hourglass figures + bright rose-pink bra-style tops + loose gray garments slipping off shoulders, arms, and hips + left person with one hand behind head + leaning close together + trees and lawn + strong streetlamp + low-light phone night shot + subtle noise and blur. Avoid: daytime, indoor bedroom, studio, harsh flash, refined commercial lighting, short hair, high ponytail, fully covering sportswear, black lingerie, red formal dress, exaggerated bodybuilder physique, extreme giant hips, heavy background blur, excessive HDR, plastic skin, anime face, CG look, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Candid portrait prompt of two young East Asian women in bright rose-pink bra tops on a park bench at night.
